user.title: Samsung TV (QN90B)
user.description: Local WebSocket control (no SmartThings). Enter the TV's IP, its MAC address (for Wake-on-LAN), a name, and optionally an existing auth token. Leave the token empty to pair via the TV's on-screen Allow popup.

pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.description: Click Continue: the token is granted automatically (no PIN). If the TV has never authorized this client, an Allow popup may appear — press Allow if it does.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV or no token was granted. Is it powered on?
